Q: Equipment inventory tracking - filter out duplicates resulting from equipment marked 'vacant', or best way to mark equipment vacant A:

I think the easiest way is to give the "correct" names to the unoccupied positions in the "Trucks" and "Positions" tables.
"Trucks" 'VACANT' -> 'VACANT_Assignee'
"Positions" 'VACANT' -> 'VACANT_Position'

SELECT Trucks.PropertyNumber, 
       nz(Drivers.DriverName,'VACANT_Assignee') as DriverName,
       Positions.PositionName
FROM (Trucks LEFT JOIN Drivers ON Drivers.DriverName = Trucks.Assignee)
LEFT JOIN Positions ON Drivers.DriverName = Positions.Incumbent
;

You should use "LEFT JOIN" instead of "INNER JOIN", to leave rows that do not meet the link conditions.
Of course, it is unlikely that a driver with the surname VACANT will appear)).
However, I think it would be more correct to link tables through identifier columns instead of names like "Trucks.AssigneeId=Drivers.DriverId".

Perhaps such a scheme (query constructor) will be more understandable.

Q: Issuing linker flags in CMake's target_link_options is still omitting the necessary wraps A:

Fixed this by using an explicit linker specifier as such:

target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE LINKER:/ENTRY:wmainCRTStartup)

You can go as far as using this for the first option as well (though may be of a more manual approach and likely a bad practice):

target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE LINKER:/SUBSYSTEM:WINDOWS LINKER:/ENTRY:wmainCRTStartup)

Q: Alternate App Icons in Xcode 26 with Icon Composer A:

I have had nothing but trouble with this exact same thing in iOS 26. My code fails to change the icon in the simulator, and on device.

"Error setting alternate icon The operation couldn’t be completed. Resource temporarily unavailable"

However, I restarted the device, and now it seems to work.

As an aside, my app has ballooned in size (from 20MB to 304MB) after adding twelve additional icons. In the Finder, they take up less than 20 MB.

Q: How can I update a Json record in Dom for each person, when their unique id is there twice, but under two different dates? A:

I decided to re-think and change the approach to the problem I was trying to solve. Rather than updating the existing records in DOM with new data from an ajax call, I decided to remove the records using $('.yourdata').empty(); thus deleting them and then creating a new set of clones with the updated data via an ajax call. Thank you all.
